source.caption: The Multiple Kernel Learning Process. A) The figure outlines key stages, including the transition from individual platforms to MKL creation, hyperparameter tuning, and subsequent model evaluation. B) The integration of three metabolomics platform datasets into kernel matrices is depicted. These matrices are then combined, incorporating corresponding weights (βm), representing a linear combination of a set of n kernels (K) .
